description: This Python module provides utility functions to load a DATABASE_URL for database connection. It attempts to read a 'db_connection.txt' file from specific locations and parse it into a PostgreSQL connection string, or alternatively retrieves the URL from environment variables. The module is intended as a helper for local or development setups to configure database connectivity.

methods.name: Optional[str] _read_db_connection_txt()
methods.description: Attempts to locate and parse 'db_connection.txt' from common locations, returning a PostgreSQL URL if successful.

methods.name: Optional[str] get_database_url()
methods.description: Retrieves the database URL from environment variables or derives it from the 'db_connection.txt' file if not set.
